reason: The fork's local-server branch is upstream 79255ce plus changes a single-machine server needs and upstream does not have yet: listen-host reads the listen address from HOST so the backend can bind to loopback; pglite-driver runs the backend on an in-process PGlite for a pglite:// database URL, with PGLITE_ASSETS_DIR and PGLITE_SHARED_BUFFERS; credentials-command lets the CLI take its token and data key from a command named by AGENT_BOARD_CREDENTIALS_COMMAND; worker-shutdown adds board internal shutdown, which ends a worker and its runs within a grace period; shutdown-idle-agent makes that shutdown kill an agent that stays alive after its turn ended.
